INPUT 1 is the approved ORIGINAL Incline Dumbbell Bench Press and the immutable, sole visual style control. Preserve its premium near-black studio, dark subtly textured floor, natural muscular adult athlete in graphite sleeveless shirt, black shorts and plain black shoes, believable skin/fabric, neutral brushed-silver equipment, broad neutral key and restrained violet rear-right rim. Same commercial fitness photography and normal-to-short-telephoto lens feel. Movement mechanics dictate a new camera/pose; do not copy the incline press pose. No new blue palette, fog, neon, shirtless posing, branding, text, numbers, watermarks, anatomy highlights or gym clutter. One athlete only, natural proportions, neutral focused expression, two anatomically plausible hands with wrapped grips, physically coherent implements and support/contact shadows. Fit the WHOLE athlete, both complete shoes, all weights/bar ends and bench/support feet within the square with about 8% breathing room; action occupies roughly 80–85% of longest image axis, not a tiny figure. Never cut off or merge equipment. Preserve full photographic detail and strong implement/torso/arm silhouette for downscaling.
Canonical MovementDefinition 525. SUITCASE CARRY. Athlete walking with one silver dumbbell held in straight right arm beside thigh, torso vertical and level resisting lateral bend. Opposite left arm swings gently; one foot planted forward and trailing heel lifting in normal SHORT WALKING stride, neither knee raised to hip height. Front-side angle makes unilateral single load and walking stance clear. Whole shoes and one intact weight.
